documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

Board Meeting Intimation for Intimation Of Board Meeting For Approval Of Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended On September 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: During the Q1 FY27 earnings conference call, Mayur Uniquoters' management reported a standalone revenue of INR247.03 crores and a consolidated revenue of INR269.23 crores, driven by higher export contributions and a favorable product mix despite a muted volume growth of 2%. Management noted margin impacts from elevated freight costs and raw material volatility, alongside ongoing evaluations for potential international and domestic expansions. The company expressed confidence in delivering a top-line growth of 10% to 15% over the next few years while monitoring geopolitical headwinds and logistics pressures. Mayur Uniquoters reported strong financial results for Q4 and FY26, driven by growth in exports and automotive segments along with operating efficiency improvements. Management guided for domestic growth of 8% to 10% and export growth of 15% to 20% on a yearly basis.

guidance.claim: The company expects top-line growth to range between 10% to 15% for the next 3 years.
guidance.quote: So, we have already said that you can expect a top line growth of between 10% to 12% for the next 3 years. This is what we can say currently right now.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the present quarter's margin is sustainable and expected to continue.
guidance.quote: But this present quarter's margin will be sustainable and expected to continue.

guidance.claim: The company expects domestic growth between 8% and 10% and export growth between 15% and 20%.
guidance.quote: So, we have said in the last phone call also, our expectation from domestic growth is between 8%-10%. And our expectation from export growth is from 15%-20%.

guidance.claim: The company targets an average revenue growth of 15% for the coming year.
guidance.quote: So we have said that we are targeting a 2-digit growth in the coming years. This year also and the coming years. So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

guidance.claim: Management expects the value growth to average around 15% for the next two years with margins remaining at similar levels.
guidance.quote: Sir, I have told you to go up by 15% on average and calculate the margin saving, then you will get a clear idea.

guidance.claim: The increased export momentum with leading OEMs is expected to continue over the next two to three years.
guidance.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the footwear market was muted in the previous quarter due to drastic increases in raw material and sole prices.
demand_outlook.quote: So obviously, the market was muted in the footwear segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that they are not looking for very strong growth in the domestic market, but expect very strong growth in the export market.
demand_outlook.quote: So anywhere between 10% to 15% growth, we are not looking very strong growth in the domestic market. But yes, we are looking at a very strong growth in the export market.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the PU business remains muted at present with sales yet to mature.
demand_outlook.quote: So, PU, still the business is muted right now. We have not been able to succeed too much in terms of the volume in PU and increasing in sales.

demand_outlook.claim: The European market is noted as a great market for marine business.
demand_outlook.quote: So our Marine business is also growing very fast and Europe is also a great market for it.

demand_outlook.claim: The Footwear business in the domestic market faces challenges due to local competition and low price margins.
demand_outlook.quote: Our Footwear business is not growing because of local competition, because of price -- low price margin. So that's why that's the only area which is a matter of concern at the moment

capex_expansion.claim: The company has ordered an additional line for expansion in current premises with production expected to start around February or March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming expansion line will provide an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.
capex_expansion.quote: So we'll have an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.

capex_expansion.claim: A capex on a global scale would be INR300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: If we do on a global scale, it will be INR300 crores over there.

capex_expansion.claim: Once a decision is taken for the South plant, it will take approximately 2 years to start with an initial capacity of 500,000 millimetres per month.
capex_expansion.quote: So once the decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start. And we will start with 500,000 millimetres per month initially.

margins_costs.claim: Management explained that last quarter's margins were abnormally high because of an abnormally high increase in foreign exchange rates.
margins_costs.quote: But last quarter, it was abnormally high because of foreign exchange increase in -- abnormally high increase in foreign exchange rates.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that shipment costs increased significantly during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: It's 4x higher, the shipment cost was increased.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that other expenses increased due to a mix of higher export shipping costs, traveling costs, and professional services.
margins_costs.quote: Some shipping cost, I already told you, shipping cost increased in this last quarter, 4x, okay, for the export and some traveling cost and other service cost, legal and professionals, etcetera, which we have incurred on that account.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices have gone up significantly as petroleum by-products, though availability issues are now resolved and prices have softened slightly.
margins_costs.quote: So, obviously, it's a petroleum by-product. So, the prices have gone up and the prices have gone up significantly. So, there was a challenge initially in the month of March where people were expecting that there could be an issue regarding the availability of the raw material. But I think those issues are resolved now. And prices have also softened a little bit from the highs of March.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses decreased during the quarter due to lower freight costs and controlled maintenance and repair costs.
margins_costs.quote: Our freight cost has gone down in this quarter because of this war situation and all and second one our maintenance cost repair and maintenance cost and consumables were also controlled and because of these two reasons our other income reduced

margins_costs.claim: Plasticizer prices and yarn prices have started going up.
margins_costs.quote: In fact, plasticizers prices have started going up. Yarn prices have started going up.

margins_costs.claim: Imports normally account for nearly one-third of the total raw material cost.
margins_costs.quote: Normally, imports are nearly 1/3 of our total raw material cost.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization is somewhere between 75% to 78%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are utilizing somewhere between 75% to 78%.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volume for the quarter was 76.3 lakh meters, which included 2.56 lakh meters of PU.
orders_capacity.quote: Total volume has been 76.3 lakh meters, including PU, which has been 2.56 lakh meters for the quarter and value 6.17.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management cited market volatility and multiple factors such as Trump tariffs and the West Asia war as reasons why a final location call for international plant expansion has not been taken.
risks_headwinds.quote: But because of all this Trump tariff, the West Asia war or multiple things happening in the last few years, we have not taken a final call where -- which should be the ideal location to put our plant.

risks_headwinds.claim: External factors like war situations temporarily impacted general export dispatches.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because there was some material that was supposed to go to the Middle East, but we could not dispatch that material, it was on hold.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the European automotive industry is experiencing a story of degrowth.
risks_headwinds.quote: But if you see, European automotive industry is not growing as much rather than it's -- there is a story of degrowth over there.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the U.S. business to increase by 60% to 70% over the next 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: Sir we have already told that our US business will increase and next in next three years the business will almost be if not double at least 60%, 70% our US business will increase, right?

management_commitments.claim: The newly ordered coating line is expected to be installed by the end of the current calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to make the company a preferred supplier for leading OEMs in overseas markets such as the US and Europe.
management_commitments.quote: Further, our endeavour is to make the company a preferred supplier for the leading OEMs, especially in overseas markets, US and European regions.

management_commitments.claim: The company has a plan to conduct plantation activities at a large scale in coming years.
management_commitments.quote: Under the Corporate Social Responsibility programs, we have contributed towards the regular plantation, around 45,000 and more plants already we have planted and have a plan to do it at large scale in coming years.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets an average revenue growth of 15% for the coming year.
management_commitments.quote: So we have said that we are targeting a 2-digit growth in the coming years. This year also and the coming years. So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects value growth of 15% for the next two years with margins remaining at similar levels.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, I have told you to go up by 15% on average and calculate the margin saving, then you will get a clear idea.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
